trigger: Scroll; tap bottom-right page number; enter number; Go.
documented_behavior: Navigates to the requested page.
verification_needed: Check page labels versus physical indexes and invalid input on device.
proposed_acceptance: A 200-page fixture reaches the chosen page; invalid input preserves position.

trigger: After jumping, tap Back to p. at bottom left.
documented_behavior: Returns to the previous page.
verification_needed: History depth, zoom retention, other jump sources and forward navigation are not specified.
proposed_acceptance: Return restores the departure position; test nested detours separately without assuming reference support.

trigger: Tap another open document tab.
documented_behavior: Tabbed view switches among opened files.
verification_needed: Verify narrow split-view access and per-file state retention.
proposed_acceptance: Three open documents retain independent position and drafts during switching.

job: Identify or rename the current file
trigger: Tap the active tab.
documented_behavior: Menu offers Rename, Reveal in file manager, and Close Other Tabs.
verification_needed: Verify save behavior and reveal destinations for provider files.
proposed_acceptance: Rename preserves identity; reveal exposes destination; closing others loses no committed work.

trigger: Hold a tab and move it.
documented_behavior: Tabs can be rearranged.
verification_needed: Verify keyboard alternative and persistence after restart.
proposed_acceptance: Reorder without changing file identity or losing active reading position.

trigger: Tap a toolset.
documented_behavior: Shows or hides its tools; defaults are Annotate, Insert, Fill & Sign.
verification_needed: Verify active-tool behavior when collapsed.
proposed_acceptance: Collapse and restore without changing selected passage or making recovery undiscoverable.

job: Keep tools near the working hand
trigger: Hold toolbar handle and drag.
documented_behavior: Toolbar moves to top, left, or right.
verification_needed: Verify orientation changes and touch targets.
proposed_acceptance: Move toolbar without moving the page; all actions remain accessible in portrait.

trigger: Open plus menu; tap or drag toolsets.
documented_behavior: Add, hide, or reorder sets; portrait displays at most three.
verification_needed: Verify overflow access and saved customization.
proposed_acceptance: Hidden sets remain reachable; reordering survives restart and rotation.

trigger: Open top-right panel; Annotations tab; tap an item.
documented_behavior: Annotations are page-ordered; tapping jumps to its page.
verification_needed: Verify exact mark visibility and same-page ordering.
proposed_acceptance: Find a saved mark and show its precise location without losing return position.

trigger: Type in annotation search.
documented_behavior: Search covers highlighted/underlined text and popup/text notes.
verification_needed: Verify Unicode and unsupported annotation classes.
proposed_acceptance: Query a note and a marked phrase; return only matching saved items.

trigger: Tap color wheel beside search; choose color.
documented_behavior: Filters annotations by color.
verification_needed: Verify interaction with text query and clearing filters.
proposed_acceptance: Color and query scope remain visible; clearing restores the complete list.

trigger: Swipe item left and delete; or Clear then Yes.
documented_behavior: Deletes one or all; toolbar undo can reverse clearing.
verification_needed: Verify undo limits across document closure.
proposed_acceptance: Single removal preserves neighbors; bulk removal requires confirmation and immediate undo.

trigger: Annotations tab; Export; name/location; Annotation Summary; Export.
documented_behavior: Produces an HTML annotation list.
verification_needed: Verify included types, escaping, ordering, and current entitlements.
proposed_acceptance: Unicode and literal HTML-like notes export safely with source/page references.

trigger: Choose Annotated Pages in annotation export.
documented_behavior: Creates a new PDF containing annotated pages.
verification_needed: Verify duplicate marks, page order and widget retention.
proposed_acceptance: Pages 2 and 5 export once each, in order, with readable marks; original is unchanged.

trigger: Annotate; Content Selection; A icon; choose Annotations or Screenshot; select area.
documented_behavior: Popup offers Copy, Erase, Create PDF, Share.
verification_needed: Which actions apply to each mode and output fidelity need device checks; iOS crop is not documented here.
proposed_acceptance: Show selected mode and boundary; never silently substitute pixels for editable annotations; cancellation changes nothing.

trigger: Annotate; Pen or Marker; style control.
documented_behavior: Sets color/thickness, Pen sensitivity or Marker opacity; choices are remembered.
verification_needed: Pencil-model response, cross-file retention and restart scope need verification.
proposed_acceptance: A chosen style remains stable through tool switching; verify pressure on real Pencil hardware.

trigger: Use two fingers while drawing; optionally configure PDF Viewer wrist protection.
documented_behavior: Two-finger scrolling works with the tool active; wrist protection ignores palm contact.
verification_needed: Verify Pencil/finger distinction, palm rejection, and device settings path.
proposed_acceptance: Pan and palm contact produce no stray marks during a real-device writing session.

trigger: Pen; Zoom Writing; write in bottom area; move/resize blue box.
documented_behavior: Magnified writing area follows the adjustable target region.
verification_needed: Verify scaling, edge advance and page rotation.
proposed_acceptance: Ink lands in the intended native-page region at different zooms, without duplicate strokes.

trigger: Select Highlight/Underline/Strikeout then text, or hold text and use popup.
documented_behavior: Creates text markup; requires a text layer; scans use Pen/Marker instead.
verification_needed: Verify Pencil selection, wrapped lines and OCR availability separately.
proposed_acceptance: Partial first/last lines match selected words; missing text layer gives an explicit alternative.

trigger: Tap marked text for Color/Clear; tap undo, or hold undo for Redo.
documented_behavior: Changes color, clears markup, undoes or redoes edits.
verification_needed: Verify history scope and hit-testing near overlapping marks.
proposed_acceptance: Modify only the intended mark; undo and redo reproduce exact content and geometry.

trigger: Tap active field or checkbox; enter text or choose value.
documented_behavior: Fills interactive fields; field highlighting can be disabled in Settings > Page Viewer.
verification_needed: Verify field types, keyboard traversal and output in another reader.
proposed_acceptance: Text, choice, radio and checkbox values survive export/reopen without changing originals.

trigger: Fill & Sign; Text, Checkmark or Cross; tap placement.
documented_behavior: Adds text or symbols to non-interactive forms.
verification_needed: Verify placement adjustment and accidental field interception.
proposed_acceptance: Place and correct entries precisely; exported appearance matches the reviewed copy.

trigger: Fill & Sign; Date; place it; tap date > Properties.
documented_behavior: Date format, font and color can be changed.
verification_needed: Verify locale, timezone and editability.
proposed_acceptance: Preview selected date format explicitly; export retains the intended date and appearance.

job: Reset answers at the intended scope
trigger: Menu > Clear Form > Yes; or select field > Clear Field on keyboard.
documented_behavior: Clears all form data after confirmation, or one selected field.
verification_needed: Verify cancellation, undo and scripts/calculated fields.
proposed_acceptance: Cancel leaves answers intact; single-field clear preserves other answers.
